name: AMC & maintenance
summary: Regular cleaning and check-ups that help your equipment run reliably.
description: Dust, heat and long running hours slowly reduce cooling and raise power bills. Our Annual Maintenance Contracts (AMC) schedule periodic servicing so problems are caught early. They suit homes with several units as well as offices, shops and facilities that cannot afford downtime.
includes: Electrical checks and gas pressure readings
Service records for every unit on site
